generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The additional test cases in `ReadOnlyDirectByteBufferBufTest` are comprehensive and cover different buffer operations and their release behavior. This ensures that the read-only nature of the buffers is maintained across various operations.
The addition of test cases for read-only buffers is a good practice to ensure that the release behavior is correctly implemented. The new tests cover various scenarios, which is beneficial.

review_comment: The reason why read-only ByteBuffers are needed in the SslHandler use case is to avoid mutating the buffer. JDK's SSLEngine will mutate the input buffer with an in-place encryption reusing the input buffer unless the buffer is read-only. The support for read-only ByteBuffers in JDK's SSLEngine was added as a result of a bug reported by @chrisvest, more details in comment https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/14069#issuecomment-2129279047 .
